subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers flows into the Arabian Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabarmati**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sabarmati** is one of the rivers that flows into the Arabian Sea.
 
• The Sabarmati River originates in the Aravalli Range of the Udaipur District of Rajasthan and flows through the state of Gujarat before emptying into the Arabian Sea.
 
• Other major rivers that flow into the Arabian Sea include the Narmada and the Tapi.
 
• The Arabian Sea is part of the northern Indian Ocean and is situated between the Indian subcontinent and the Arabian Peninsula.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Godavari** is the second-longest river in India but it flows into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• **The Luni** is an endorheic river, meaning it does not flow into any sea or ocean but ends in the Rann of Kutch.
 
• **The Krishna** River is one of the longest rivers in India, flowing into the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Rivers play a crucial role in the geography, economy, and culture of the regions they flow through, providing water for irrigation, drinking, and industrial purposes.
